newsitem.title: USA: World Airways says block hours up in Jan.
newsitem.headline: World Airways says block hours up in Jan.

text.p: World Airways Inc said Thursday it had 3,853 block hours flown from continuing operations in January, up 23 percent from 3,131 in January 1996.
Block hours denote flying hours under contracts with international air carriers, the U.S. Air Force and international tour operators, the company said.
Average daily utilization in January was 9.6 block hours against 9.8 block hours in the comparable month in 1996.
World Airways is owned 61 percent by WorldCorp, 18 percent by MHS Berhad, of Malaysia, and 21 percent by public investors.
